<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" targetNamespace="http://www.blizzard.com/bpmn/character-generator">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CharacterGenerator" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" name="Start character creation">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Start_Split" name="Split into two activities">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ComeUpWithNames" name="Come up with good character names">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HasBattleNet" name="Has battle.net account?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAccountInfo" name="Enter account information">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click confirmation link in mail">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BattleNet_Merge" name="Battle.net account available">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HasSubscription" name="Active WoW subscription?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod" name="Select payment method">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCreditCard" name="Enter credit card information">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterIBANBIC" name="Enter IBAN and BIC numbers">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Merge" name="Payment method entered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Subscription_Merge" name="Subscription active">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Setup_Join" name="Account setup and names ready">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIntoGame" name="Log into the game">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRealmRaceClass" name="Select realm, race and class">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterName" name="Enter next character name">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Name available?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send confirmation and character selfies">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_ExpansionReleased" messageRef="Message_ExpansionReleased"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ExpansionMessageReceived" name="Expansion message received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" targetRef="Gateway_Start_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Gateway_HasBattleNet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_HasBattleNet" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_HasBattleNet" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNet_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInfo" targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNet_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNet_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_HasSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_HasSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_HasSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Credit card" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCard"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Bank account" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterIBANBIC"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCard" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_EnterIBANBIC" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_Setup_Join" targetRef="Task_LogIntoGame"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_LogIntoGame" targetRef="Task_SelectRealmRaceClass"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_SelectRealmRaceClass" targetRef="Task_EnterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_EnterName" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" name="Name taken" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_EnterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" name="Name available" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Event_ExpansionReleased"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Event_ExpansionReleased" targetRef="EndEvent_ExpansionMessageReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
